statements.chinese: 你有很多事情可以做！

statements.english: Like what ?

statements.chinese: 还有冰！

statements.english: because I actually didn't get a callback
statements.chinese: 因为我确实没有接到回电。

statements.english: You got a callback too didn't you ?
statements.chinese: 你也接到复试通知了，对吧？

statements.english: Yeah I did !
statements.chinese: 没错，就是我干的！

statements.english: Hey Rachel , what are you doing out here ?
statements.chinese: 嘿 Rachel，你在这里做什么呢？

statements.english: Oh well , it's kinda lonely up there
statements.chinese: 唉，那里还真是有点寂寞呢，

statements.english: so I just thought I would come out here and get some fresh air
statements.chinese: 所以我就想着出来透透气。

statements.chinese: Nancy和我正在讨论秋季系列。

statements.english: Oh great !
statements.chinese: 太好了！

statements.english: So anyway we really ..
statements.chinese: 所以无论如何我们真的...

statements.chinese: 亲爱的，对不起，我们抽烟熏到你了。

statements.chinese: 哦，抱歉！

statements.chinese: 哦，没关系。

statements.chinese: 不不不，我们会挪动，你就待在那儿别动。

statements.chinese: 你知道我把设计稿发给Ralph了

statements.chinese: 我以为你不抽烟。

statements.chinese: 哦，我以为你们说的是大麻烟。

statements.chinese: 但事实上，我一直抽的都是普通款。

statements.chinese: 哦，我也是。

statements.english: I'm kidding
